bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 71
cid="${ids[0]}"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$cid")" = true || exit 72
docker exec "$cid" sh -c 'grep -Fq "startPayload===\"link\"" /app/gaybbs.mjs' || exit 73
db="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres | head -n 1)"
test -n "$db" || exit 74
gates="$(docker exec "$db" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='link' AND enabled=TRUE;")" || exit 75
test "$gates" -eq 1 || exit 76
panels="$(docker exec "$db" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(DISTINCT chat_id) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' AND state='published' AND message_id IS NOT NULL AND chat_id IN (-1003847210571,-1002373696859,-1003770334893);")" || exit 77
test "$panels" -eq 3 || exit 78
echo LINK_PRODUCTION_ROUTER_AND_THREE_MENU_DB=PASS
